name: @viruspc/edges
description: Multi-command Edges CLI (notes, tasks, skills, and more)

scripts.build: node --input-type=module -e "import {rmSync} from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true})" && pnpm run build:schemas && pnpm run build:tasks-review-app && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node ./scripts/copy-review-page-asset.mjs && node --import tsx ./scripts/copy-memory-templates.ts && node --import tsx ./scripts/copy-bundled-skills.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run build:schemas && pnpm run build:tasks-review-app && node --test --test-concurrency=1 --import tsx --import ./test/register-skills-install-mock.ts './test/**/*.test.ts'
